one_line: King of Avanti, ruling the crossroads city of Ujjain at the junction of Uttarapatha and Dakshinapatha trade routes.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic but not bulky, with the wiry build of a horseman used to travel and campaign.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown Malwa complexion, straight nose, sharp dark-brown eyes under slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; default expression calm and calculating, with a faint half-smile as if weighing a bargain.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair, shoulder-length, oiled and pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head; a simple narrow white cotton headband across the forehead, tied at the back with short trailing ends.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early historic western Indian attire: a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with overlapping front panels tied on the right side, long fitted sleeves and a modest round neckline; over this, a deep indigo-dyed cotton or fine wool shawl (uttariya) with a subtle narrow border in brick-red and cream, draped from the left shoulder across the torso and wrapped once around the waist; lower garment is a brick-red cotton dhoti-like wrap tightly pleated in front and reaching to the ankles, with the pleats slightly visible; a simple broad brown leather belt at the waist to support a dagger; feet in sturdy dark-brown leather sandals with a toe loop and ankle thong; jewellery limited to a single copper armlet on the right biceps, a pair of small plain copper hoop earrings, and a simple bead bracelet (carnelian and grey stone) on the left wrist, hinting at trade connections.
appearance.signature: A short iron sword with a straight single-edged blade, simple wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather and no elaborate guard, hanging at his left side in a plain brown leather scabbard suspended from the belt; in his left hand he often holds a small cloth pouch of fish-type punch-marked coins, a few coins subtly visible at the opening.

ref_desc: Pradyota is a wiry mid-30s king with medium-brown skin, shoulder-length black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white angarkha, deep indigo shawl, brick-red dhoti, leather sandals, copper jewellery, and carrying a simple iron sword and a pouch of punch-marked coins.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pradyota of Ujjain: a wiry mid-30s king with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, straight nose and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his default expression calm and calculating with a faint half-smile; his thick black hair is shoulder-length, oiled and pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head, with a narrow white cotton headband across his forehead tied at the back with short trailing ends. He wears an off-white knee-length cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with overlapping front panels tied on the right side, long fitted sleeves and a modest round neckline, over which a deep indigo shawl with a narrow brick-red and cream border is draped from the left shoulder across the torso and wrapped once around the waist. His lower garment is a brick-red cotton dhoti-like wrap tightly pleated in front and reaching the ankles, held by a simple broad brown leather belt that also supports a plain brown leather scabbard at his left, containing a short straight single-edged iron sword with a simple wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather. He stands in sturdy dark-brown leather sandals with a toe loop and ankle thong, and wears minimal jewellery: a copper armlet on the right biceps, small plain copper hoop earrings, and a bead bracelet of carnelian and grey stone on the left wrist. In his left hand he holds a small cloth pouch with a few fish-type punch-marked coins peeking from the opening, emphasizing his connection to Ujjain’s traders; ensure the dominant colours are off-white, deep indigo, brick red, dark brown and copper, and show front, side and back views to clearly display hair, clothing, sword and coin pouch.
